gddm(): `bound` must be one boundary component, from gddm_bound_constant(), gddm_bound_exponential(), gddm_bound_linear() or gddm_bound_term().
gddm(): `start` must be one starting-point component, from gddm_start_point(), gddm_start_uniform() or gddm_start_term().
gddm(): `control` must come from gddm_control().

gddm: vreal1 is not constant within every condition. One solve serves a whole condition, so a covariate the drift reads has to take one value there. Split the condition index, or build it with gddm_conditions().

gddm: max_ndt = 10 is above the smallest response time (0.3800421). The density is zero at and below the non-decision time, so a bound above min(rt) admits parameter values with no likelihood.
